status: RESEARCH OUTPUT. Calibrated on daily proxy gaps (conservative superset of the oracle-blind exposure); not an audited or governance-approved set.

split.note: structure selected on 2015-2017 validation; deployment fit below is refit on the full history; out-of-sample evidence in results/ uses the train-only fit.

units.gap_var: log bps, used as loss fraction (conservative: 1-exp(-v) < v)

estimator.name: pooled-scaled EWMA, lambda=0.9
estimator.recurrence: num' = lambda*num + (loss/k_c)^2 ; den' = lambda*den + 1 ; sigma2 = num/den (bps^2, weekend units)
estimator.forecast: gapVaR_c = multiplier_c * z_q * k_c * sqrt(sigma2)  [round up]
